task.title: Onboarding Checklist: New Technical Writer
task.shortdesc: Practical checklist to onboard a new writer to the repository and build process.

step.cmd: Fork and clone the repo; verify you can run a local build.
Read the `technical_writer_guide.dita` to learn structure and conventions.
Find a small topic to edit (typo fix or example expansion) and open a PR with a brief description and reviewers.
Verify output and include screenshots or HTML snippets in the PR when relevant.
After merge, confirm CI artifacts (HTML/PDF) are uploaded to the PR by the workflow.
